The purity of the knower is the purity of body-consciousness. That which is the purity of body-consciousness is the purity of the knower. Thus, the purity of the knower and the purity of body-consciousness are not two; they cannot be divided, they are not separate, and they are not distinct.

The purity of the seer is the purity of body-consciousness. That which is the purity of body-consciousness is the purity of the seer. Thus, the purity of the seer and the purity of body-consciousness are not two; they cannot be divided, they are not separate, and they are not distinct.

<summary>This page discusses the non-dual nature of consciousness, asserting that the purity of the subject who knows or sees is identical to the purity of sensory body-consciousness. It emphasizes that these states are inseparable and lack any inherent distinction.</summary>
<keywords>non-duality, body-consciousness, purity, knower, seer, sensory perception, Buddhist philosophy</keywords>
